reading.body:
Rackspace operates three data centers across two states, but detailed specifications remain unavailable. Neither the company's own resource pages nor available public sources provide power consumption, square footage, or complete street addresses for these facilities.

The three facilities cluster geographically. Two buildings occupy adjacent sites in Somerset County, New Jersey, approximately 440 meters apart, suggesting a shared campus. The third sits in Richardson, Texas within the Dallas-Fort Worth metro area. Rackspace traces its presence in Somerset to the Datapipe acquisition in 2017, though Datapipe operated a data center there as early as 2010.

This registry holds facility locations but not the operational metrics that determine data center relevance to AI scaling. Without power draw, utilization rates, or hardware specifications, these coordinates indicate where Rackspace stores customer infrastructure, not how much compute capacity they support or how much electrical infrastructure supports those buildings. The data shows that Rackspace, a major colocation provider, maintains multiple regional footprints, but cannot answer whether these sites serve AI workloads or remain focused on legacy managed hosting customers.
